category.title: Full Body
category.intro: Circuit programmes that work your legs, glutes, chest, back and core together in a single workout. Every workout has a push, a pull, a leg and a core move, and full-body moves like burpees and inchworms also build conditioning.
science: When the total work is the same, how many days a week you train a muscle doesn't meaningfully change muscle growth; a full-body programme is as effective as split programmes (an analysis of 25 studies).
Bodyweight circuit training gives you intense exercise in a short time; however, the evidence comes from small studies.
Including a push, pull, leg and core move in every workout helps prevent muscle imbalances.
Moves like burpees raise your heart rate quickly; at the start, choose the version without the jump.

exercises.name: Half Burpee
steps: Crouch and put your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position, then bring your feet back towards your hands.
Stand up.
exercises.tip: If jumping your feet back is too hard, step them back one at a time.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag in the plank position.

exercises.name: Burpee
steps: Crouch, put your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a push-up position.
Bring your feet back towards your hands.
Jump with your arms up and land softly.
exercises.tip: Good form before speed; when you get tired, drop the jump and do half burpees.
exercises.mistake: Don't land hard; land quietly with your knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Inchworm
steps: Bend forward and put your hands on the floor in front of your feet; bend your knees if needed.
Walk your hands forward into a push-up position.
Walk your hands back towards your feet and stand up.
exercises.tip: It's also a great move for warming up.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips sag in the plank.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.target: Front of the thighs, glutes and hamstrings
exercises.setup: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
steps: Push your hips back and lower down; reach your arms forward.
Stop when your thighs are close to parallel with the floor; chest up.
Push through your heels to stand up.
exercises.tip: Breathe in on the way down and out on the way up.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your knees cave in or your heels lift off the floor.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
steps: Lower into a squat.
Jump up explosively, arms up.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent and go straight into the next squat.
exercises.tip: Try to land without noise; the quieter the landing, the more controlled it is.
exercises.mistake: Don't land with locked knees; if your knee hurts, do a normal squat.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.target: Front of the thighs and glutes
steps: Take a big step back with one foot and lower by bending both knees.
Stop when your back knee nears the floor; your front knee is over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return to the start; switch legs halfway through.
exercises.tip: The reverse lunge is kinder to the knee than the forward lunge.
exercises.mistake: Don't lean your body forward; stay upright.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, soles of your feet on the floor hip-width apart. Arms by your sides.
steps: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips off the floor; form a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Keep your glutes tight at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Press through your heels; you can lift your toes slightly.

exercises.name: Kneeling Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, knees on the floor, feet in the air. Form a straight line from your head to your knees.
steps: Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the floor.
Stop when your chest is a fist's height from the floor.
Push back up to straighten your arms.
exercises.tip: Move to the full push-up once you can do 20 clean reps comfortably.
exercises.mistake: Don't go down by just dipping your head; lower your whole body together.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.target: Chest, front shoulders, triceps and core
exercises.setup: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, arms straight, on your toes. A straight line from your head to your heels.
steps: Lower your chest to the floor with your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.
Stop when your elbows are bent at least 90 degrees.
Push the floor away to straighten your arms.
exercises.tip: Gently squeeze your belly and glutes; keep your body stiff like a plank.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop or rise; don't flare your elbows straight out.

exercises.name: Chair Dips
exercises.setup: Stand in front of a sturdy chair placed against a wall. Put your hands behind you on the edge of the chair, knees bent, feet on the floor.
steps: Bend your elbows backwards and lower your hips.
Stop when your elbows reach 90 degrees.
Push up with your palms.
exercises.tip: The further you extend your legs, the harder the move.
exercises.mistake: Don't hunch your shoulders towards your ears; if your shoulder hurts, go down less.

exercises.name: Under-Table Row
exercises.target: Back width, rear shoulders and biceps
exercises.setup: Lie on your back under a sturdy table that won't tip over. Hold the edge of the table shoulder-width apart; heels on the floor, body straight.
steps: Pull your chest towards the table; your elbows go back, not out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Bending your knees makes the move easier. Make sure the table is sturdy.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop; keep a straight line from heels to shoulders.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.setup: Lie face down, arms stretched out in front of your head, legs straight.
steps: Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
exercises.tip: Keep your eyes on the floor; don't bend your neck upwards.
exercises.mistake: Don't force it high; lifting a few centimetres is enough.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.setup: Get on all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
steps: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Pause briefly when your arm and leg are parallel to the floor.
Bring them back slowly; switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: Imagine a glass of water on your back; don't spill it.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag or your hips turn to the side.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Lie face down. Put your elbows under your shoulders and lift your body onto your toes.
steps: Form a straight line from your head to your heels.
Draw your belly in and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe easily and hold until the time is up.
exercises.tip: If your form breaks, put your knees down and carry on.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop or rise.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: Get into a push-up position: hands under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line.
steps: Pull your right knee towards your chest.
As you take it back, pull your left knee in.
Keep going in rhythm with your hips steady.
exercises.tip: Get the form right before you speed up; slow is fine.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift your hips up or let your back sag.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.target: Deep abdominal muscles and core stability
exercises.setup: Lie on your back. Reach your arms to the ceiling and lift your knees into the air, bent at 90 degrees.
steps: Slowly extend your right arm behind your head and your left leg forward.
Return to the start.
Do the same with your left arm and right leg.
exercises.tip: Breathe out as you extend; keep your lower back touching the floor the whole time.
exercises.mistake: If your lower back lifts, extend your leg less.
